findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "INTEGRATED COMPUTER LABORATORY SYSTEM" above "DEVELOPER BY ICLABS"; "DETAIL ARSITEKTUR SISTEM" above "Satu ekosistem. Semua terhubung."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 6 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "PILIH SISTEM:", "INTEGRATED COMPUTER LABORATORY SYSTEM", "MANY MINDS · ONE ECOSYSTEM · CONNECTED B", "IN FOCUS [1/22]").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 5 gradient fill(s): div#arena-stage-scroll.esports-arena-stage → radial-gradient(at 50% 90%, rgb(19, 36, 47) 0%, rgb(8, 17, 23) 48%, rgb(5, 8, 11) 85%) | div.arena-backdrop-grid → linear-gradient(rgba(92, 225, 230, 0.05) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(92, 225, 230, | div.arena-spotlight-beam → radial-gradient(at 50% 20%, rgba(92, 225, 230, 0.22) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 65%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 23 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.system-pill-btn.is-active → rgba(92, 225, 230, 0.35) 0px 0px 14px -3px | div.esports-player-badge → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 4px 12px 0px | div.esports-player-badge → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 4px 12px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 1 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1392px | div.esports-bottom-bar 1392px | section#project-detail.project-detail-section 1392px | section#team.team-section 1392px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 7 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 95 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 60 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 54px (3.8vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: A 380px stretch at 104px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("DEVELOPER BY ICLABS") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 40% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×360px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "DEVELOPER BY ICLABS" (screen 1, 75% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The h1 is 26px ("DEVELOPER BY ICLABS").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "PILIH SISTEM:" (14px from the left); "Rekrutmen" (14px from the right); "DETAIL ARSITEKTUR SISTEM" (14px from the left); "Satu ekosistem." (14px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "PILIH SISTEM:" (14px); "Praktikum" (14px); "DETAIL ARSITEKTUR SISTEM" (14px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 21 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "AAN MS", "ANDI AHSAN ASHURI", "ANDI RIFQI AUNUR RAHMAN 1", "FARAH"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
